verdict.rationale: An AI assistant like Copilot could plausibly offer a developer API, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only end-user chat, Office app integrations, connectors and browser actions, with no versioned API and no deprecation policy. Probes for an OpenAPI spec at the support domain all returned 404, so there is no evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
